name: Provida
tagline: Hold the whole picture of your parent's care in one calm place.
positioning: Provida is the coordination home base for families caring for an aging parent — one shared record for medications, appointments, caregivers, and hard decisions.

hero.h1: Everyone caring for Mom, finally on the same page.
hero.sub: Stop reconstructing your father's care from group texts, sticky notes, and half-remembered phone calls. Provida keeps meds, appointments, and updates in one shared record the whole family can trust.

features.title: One living care record
features.description: Diagnoses, medications, doses, and doctors in a single timeline. When the dose changes at 9pm, everyone sees it — not just whoever answered the phone.

features.title: Shared family log
features.description: A running journal of visits, moods, and small worries. Your sibling three states away reads the same notes the in-home aide wrote this morning.

features.title: Appointments that don't slip
features.description: Track every cardiologist, dentist, and follow-up with reminders and who's driving. Missed-visit chaos becomes a calendar you can actually read.

features.title: Medication safety checks
features.description: Log each prescription with schedule and pharmacy. Provida flags overlapping doses and refills running low before the bottle is empty.

features.title: Document vault
features.description: Power of attorney, insurance cards, advance directives — scanned, labeled, and findable in the ER at 2am instead of a shoebox at home.

features.title: Caregiver handoffs
features.description: Aides and family members log hours and notes on the same shift board, so nothing gets dropped between the day shift and dinner.

testimonials.quote: My brother and I stopped fighting about who forgot what. Provida's log became the one thing we both trusted. When Dad was hospitalized, I handed the nurse his med list in thirty seconds.
testimonials.name: Danielle Okafor
testimonials.role: Primary caregiver, caring for her father

testimonials.quote: I manage care for eleven clients' parents. Before Provida I lived in spreadsheets and voicemail. Now every family sees the same timeline I do, and the questions finally stopped repeating.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: Mom has six prescriptions and three doctors who don't talk to each other. Provida caught a dangerous overlap none of us noticed. That alone was worth every dollar.
testimonials.name: Susan Whitfield

pricing.blurb: For one person coordinating care for a single parent.
For siblings and relatives sharing the load together.
For families working with paid aides and care managers.

homepage.footerBlurb: Provida helps families coordinate care for an aging parent with one shared, trustworthy record — so no one carries the whole weight alone.
